first_cycle.first_60_seconds: Open a draft note and write its purpose in one sentence.

story.domain: Choose the area of life this conduct belongs to.
story.why_hard: Name the moment, environment or trigger where your old default is strongest. This is not known yet.
story.if_true: Choose five repeatable behaviors that would follow from this conduct identity. Check them against your actual time and support.
story.ordinary_day: A starting point to adapt to an ordinary day: Open a draft note and write its purpose in one sentence. Keep the action small enough for a regular day.
story.comes_with: Check the practical demands on your time, energy, money and relationships. Name one trade-off you can realistically support.
story.when_you_slip: Return at the next safe, appropriate opportunity. If misses repeat, review the action size, setting and support; adjust or rest when needed.
story.signs_working: Look for changes in what you do and how you return after a miss. Record an observation; these are signals to look for, not promised results.
story.example: Hypothetical moment, not a report about you: an ordinary day feels crowded. Choose a safe small start from your plan: Open a draft note and write its purpose in one sentence. Record what actually happened, if anything.
story.assistant_prompt: Help me review this HALO Blueprint. Ask about my old default and hardest trigger. Review The Decision, Ask in the Moment, Why It's Hard, If This Is True, An Ordinary Day, What Comes With It, When You Slip, Signs It's Working and an Example. Use plain language, no guarantees or invented observations. Keep consequential decisions for appropriate qualified review.
